In mathematics, a '''tall cardinal''' is a [[large cardinal]] ''κ'' that is ''θ''-tall for all ordinals ''θ'', where a cardinal is called ''θ''-tall if there is an [[elementary embedding]] ''j''&nbsp;:&nbsp;''V''&nbsp;→&nbsp;''M'' with critical point ''κ'' such that ''j''(''κ'')&nbsp;>&nbsp;θ and ''M''<sup>''κ''</sup>&nbsp;⊆&nbsp;M.

Tall cardinals are [[equiconsistent]] with [[strong cardinal]]s.
